# StreamDek Mobile v2.0.5

## What's New

- Added secure playback handoff to connected StreamDek TVs, preserving the selected source, quality, episode, and playback position.
- Added profile-scoped Live TV favourites that sync with the StreamDek TV app.
- Added automatic stream fallback so playback can continue with the next suitable source when the selected source fails.
- Added plugin source testing with title-aware samples: anime providers now test Attack on Titan or Spirited Away instead of The Matrix.

## Improvements

- Plugin sources are ordered alphabetically and sources with extra configuration expose a settings control.
- Plugin tests now support both movie and series providers and return concise, human-readable failures instead of JavaScript stack dumps.
- Improved plugin repository URL handling, including manifests served from explicit JSON and extensionless endpoints.
- Account email addresses are obfuscated by default and can be revealed temporarily with the visibility control.
- Improved device identity reconciliation to prevent duplicate mobile and TV sessions after reinstalling or reconnecting.

## Privacy and Fixes

- Handoff payloads are end-to-end encrypted for the selected TV, expire after two minutes, and are removed after delivery or expiry.
- Synced favourite records exclude playable stream URLs and request headers.
- Fixed movie and series playback reloading a few seconds after playback had already started.
- Fixed automatic stream selection failing to move to the next source when the first candidate could not play.
- Fixed several plugin compatibility and repository installation errors, including opaque HTTP and JavaScript error output.
